findings.summary: No securitySchemes and no root securedBy: — API is fully open.
findings.impact: Any client can call any endpoint. Hard fail for any non-public API.
findings.remediation_code:
securitySchemes:
  oauth_2_0:
    type: OAuth 2.0
    settings:
      authorizationUri: https://auth.example.com/oauth/authorize
      accessTokenUri: https://auth.example.com/oauth/token
      authorizationGrants: [ authorization_code, client_credentials ]

securedBy: [ oauth_2_0 ]

findings.summary: 6 methods do not declare the full required error set (400/401/404/500).
findings.impact: Consumers have no contract for failure modes. Code generation, mocking, and MUnit are all impacted.

findings.summary: Orchestration verb in resource path ('payment-process') — belongs to a Process API, not a System API.
findings.impact: Mixing nouns with orchestration verbs in the same spec means the API layer is undeclared and violates Single Responsibility per layer.
findings.remediation_text: Either expose the entity as a noun (System API) or extract this resource into a separate Process API.

findings.impact: Anypoint Exchange listing will be uninformative; downstream developers cannot determine fit-for-purpose.
findings.remediation_code:
description: |
  System API exposing customer orders and user account operations
  for the retail platform. Backed by the OMS and IAM service.
  Consumed by the Order Management Process API.

findings.impact: Inconsistent URL ergonomics and against MuleSoft naming guidance.

findings.summary: Title 'customerOrderAPI' does not follow the s-/p-/x- layer convention.
findings.impact: API-Led catalogs sort and filter by layer prefix; this API will not be discoverable as System / Process / Experience in Anypoint Exchange.
findings.remediation_code:
title: s-customer-orders-api    # System layer
# or
title: p-order-management-api  # Process layer
# or
title: x-web-orders-api        # Experience layer

findings.summary: Pagination duplicated on 2 resources without a trait.
findings.impact: Future pagination changes (defaults, max page size, link headers) require editing every resource.
findings.remediation_code:
traits:
  pageable:
    queryParameters:
      page:     { type: integer, default: 1, minimum: 1 }
      pageSize: { type: integer, default: 25, minimum: 1, maximum: 100 }

/customer-orders:
  get:
    is: [ pageable ]

findings.summary: 2 sensitive endpoint(s) lack an explicit securedBy: with a narrow scope.
findings.impact: Sensitive routes (payment, auth, password, credentials) should declare a method-specific scope, not inherit the root scope.

findings.summary: 3 request bodies have no inline example.
findings.impact: Mocking Service, API Designer 'Try it', and consumer SDK generators all rely on `example`.
findings.remediation_code:
post:
  body:
    application/json:
      type: CustomerOrderRequest
      example:
        customerId: "CUST-00042"
        items: [ { sku: "SKU-001", quantity: 2 } ]

findings.location: GET /customerOrders → 200 (application/json); POST /customerOrders → 201 (application/json); GET /customerOrders/{orderId} → 200 (application/json); POST /payment-process → 200 (application/json); GET /users → 200 (application/json) (+1 more)
findings.summary: 6 response bodies have no inline example per status code.
findings.impact: Consumers cannot stub or mock against the contract.

findings.summary: {version} placeholder is not interpolated in baseUri.
findings.impact: Consumers cannot pin to a major version via the URL; parallel rollout (v1 → v2) is impossible.

findings.remediation_text: Add a one-line description on every resource.

findings.summary: Title should start with the layer prefix (s-/p-/x-) for instant identification.
No documentation: section with onboarding guide.
findings.remediation_code:
documentation:
  - title: Overview
    content: |
      This API exposes ...
  - title: Getting started
    content: !include docs/getting-started.md

findings.summary: Once authentication is added, prefer OAuth 2.0 over basic auth.
Use semantic versioning (v1, v2) in the URI; reserve patch/minor for the changelog.
findings.remediation_code: version: v1   # patch level v1.2.3 belongs in changelogs/headers
